description: This file defines the HttpRequestEvent class, a custom workflow activity for handling HTTP request events within the OrchardCore framework. It includes properties for HTTP method, URL, antiforgery validation, token lifespan, and form location key, as well as methods for execution logic and outcome determination.

classes.name: HttpRequestEvent
classes.description: A workflow activity class that triggers on HTTP request events, allowing configuration of request properties and handling form data within OrchardCore workflows.

methods.name: HttpRequestEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing localizer and HTTP context accessor dependencies.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the static event name for this activity.

methods.name: DisplayText
methods.description: Localized display text for the activity.

methods.name: Category
methods.description: Localized category label for the activity.

methods.name: CanExecute
methods.description: Determines if the activity can execute based on the HTTP method matching the request method.

methods.name: ExecuteAsync
methods.description: Executes the activity, processing form data if present, and updates workflow output with form location.

methods.name: GetPossibleOutcomes
methods.description: Returns the possible outcomes for the activity, currently only 'Done'.

methods.name: GetLocationUrl
methods.description: Helper method to prepend '~' to relative URLs starting with '/'.
